payload.description:
As a maintainer I accept leftover probes for products we do not subscribe to only when the author supplies a working PR, redacted fixtures, and help re-verifying when vendor URLs move.

See docs/contributing-providers.md.

Feature: community providers
  Scenario: missing fixture is rejected
    Given a pull request for a product Anthus does not run
    And it has no redacted leftover JSON fixture
    When maintainers review
    Then the provider is not merged
payload.title: Providers Anthus does not run land only via working PRs plus verification
